:::{#def-predicted-probability}
#### Predicted probability

The **predicted probability** of [class](#def-class) $k$ at [features](model-validation.qmd#def-feature) $x$ is
the [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) that a [fitted model](model-validation.qmd#def-fitted-model) gives of the [conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-conditional-prob) of that class given those features:

$$\est{\Prf{Y = k \given x}} \eqdef \text{the fitted model's estimate of } \Prf{Y = k \given x}$$ {#eq-predicted-probability}

:::
